title: Synthesis Notes (Loudon)
idiom: Renaissance red-chalk drawing, a wave carved out of a marble block, the chisel laid down
hero_prompt: Red chalk drawing on cream paper, a Renaissance sculptor's study sheet drawn in sanguine chalk line and loose diagonal hatching with touches of white chalk, the bare cream paper showing everywhere around the drawing, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible chalk stroke and paper grain, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no realistic textures, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: a rough block of marble sketched on a plain workbench, its left side still raw and jagged; from its right side one long smooth wave has been carved free, a rolling curve rising and falling twice as it emerges from the stone, half freed; a few marble chips on the bench, and a mallet and a flat chisel laid beside the block. Sanguine, cream and soft white only.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a sanguine red-brown ground, no shading or gradients: a thick square block whose top edge has been carved into one smooth bold wave curve, with a chisel leaning against its side. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
